# Building Permit Processing Agent — Delivery Runbook

## Prerequisites

| Recipe prerequisite | Recorded requirement |
| --- | --- |
| Copilot Studio plugin | mcs-assistant@copilot-studio-plugin |
| Minimum PAC CLI version | 2.9.3 |
| Authoring mode | cli-copilot |
| Portable tool to verify | BuildingPermitProcessingAgent |
| Build workload | 24 captured manual build steps · 7 skills · 2 knowledge files · 5 acceptance checks · 5 locked cases |

### Delivery prerequisites

| Requirement | Confirm before building |
| --- | --- |
| Licensing and capacity | Confirm licensing for your tenant and Copilot Credits for building and testing the GitHub Copilot harness agent; do not assume the unpublished permit workshop is free to run. |
| Environment and maker access | Record the approved permit environment, publisher prefix and maker access. Confirm the reviewed Sonnet46 model is available without changing the workshop's Draft boundary. |
| DLP and data policy | Have the administrator review uploaded permit documents, proposed Dynamics 365 Customer Service, SharePoint and Microsoft Teams access, and channel restrictions; document rather than bypass blocked paths. |
| Identity and audience | Review GroupMembership access, Integrated authentication and the Always authentication trigger in the supplied settings; name the maker, staff audience and production access approver. |
| Connection ownership | Name owners for permit records, plan documents and field coordination. Record dedicated target-environment references and read-only identities; leave live connections out of the workshop. |
| Test identities | Prepare technician, reviewer, inspector and denied-access identities for an approved test deployment. Makers use Draft Preview; sharing must not become a reason to publish the workshop. |
| Tooling by build lane | Manual lane uses the Copilot Studio browser and reviewed uploads. Easy mode requires VS Code Agent mode, the Microsoft Copilot Studio plugin and PAC CLI 2.9.3 or newer. |
| Municipal rule ownership | Have the permit owner approve real intake, review clocks, fee schedules and inspection-review responsibilities before replacing the fixed fictional records and rules. |

### Delivery roles

| Role | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| Permit service owner | Approve intake, review-clock and escalation rules and production success measures; distinguish recommendations from authorized municipal decisions. |
| Plan reviewers and inspection lead | Review checklist scope, routing and coverage recommendations; retain permit, compliance and inspection decisions instead of delegating them to the synthetic agent. |
| Copilot Studio maker | Preserve the fixed snapshot, reviewed instructions, two knowledge files and all seven skills; capture the actual inspector-skill validation outcome and keep the build Draft. |
| Power Platform administrator | Confirm tenant licensing, capacity, environment access, authenticated audience and data policies before production permit integrations are enabled. |
| Municipal connection owners | Approve dedicated Dynamics 365 Customer Service, SharePoint and Microsoft Teams references, their identities and read-only access; own connection failures and replacements. |
| Acceptance reviewer | Check BPP-01 through BPP-05 and refusal tests on the current Draft; reject historical published-pilot, blank and reshoot-required images as current proof. |
| Operations owner | Own production session and credit monitoring, support and configuration recovery; escalate permit, fee and inspection decisions to the responsible human reviewers. |

## Phase 1 — Easy Mode with GitHub Copilot

Choose one of three alternative build lanes: GitHub Copilot authors the source-controlled Draft here. After this lane, continue to Phase 4.

1. Open GitHub Copilot Chat in VS Code, select Agent mode, and attach the [Copilot-only workshop skill](../../skills/aibast-easy-mode-copilot/SKILL.md).

2. Send the reviewed messages below in order. The skill verifies the Microsoft Copilot Studio plugin and PAC prerequisites; inspect its resulting project and evidence.

### Shared build messages

From [EASY-MODE-COPILOT-CHAT.md — 2. Build and test the solution](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/EASY-MODE-COPILOT-CHAT.md#2-build-and-test-the-solution):

```text
Give me Building Permit Processing using Easy Mode and test it for me.
```

From [EASY-MODE-COPILOT-CHAT.md — 3. Deploy the validated Draft](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/EASY-MODE-COPILOT-CHAT.md#3-deploy-the-validated-draft):

```text
Deploy it into Copilot Studio for me.
```

3. Check the Draft against the [single inventory](2.Architecture.md#skill-inventory): 7 skills and 2 knowledge files. Use synthetic inputs only; neither publication nor live-system connections belong in this lane.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The permit project uses cli-copilot in the approved environment; the release target remains unpublished. [Source](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/deployment.json)
- [ ] This lane's permit Preview evidence identifies the current agent, model, inventory and Draft state. [Source](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/FIELD-GUIDE.md)

## Phase 2 — Optional Brainstem Track

Choose one of three alternative build lanes: this optional track adds local Brainstem validation. It is not a prerequisite for the browser build; continue to Phase 4 when it is complete.

1. Attach the [Brainstem workshop skill](../../skills/aibast-easy-mode-brainstem/SKILL.md) instead of the Copilot-only skill.

2. Reuse the [shared build messages from Phase 1](#shared-build-messages); do not repeat that lane separately.

3. Follow [the local installation recipe](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/deployment.json) for `building_permit_processing_agent.py`. Verify `BuildingPermitProcessingAgent` at `http://localhost:7071/health` and run its smoke test.

4. Use the [locked acceptance matrix](4.Sample-prompts.md#per-case-acceptance-matrix) for isolated local runs. Record the actual results, then complete target Draft validation. [Full optional-track procedure](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/EASY-MODE-PERSONLESS.md).

### Exit criteria

- [ ] If chosen, the recipe smoke test calls `BuildingPermitProcessingAgent` and returns its required markers. [Source](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/deployment.json)
- [ ] Record completion or non-use of the optional permit track without claiming an unperformed validation. [Source](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/FIELD-GUIDE.md)

## Phase 3 — Manual Build in Copilot Studio

Choose one of three alternative build lanes: build the agent directly in the Copilot Studio browser. No Python, local runtime, CLI import or earlier build lane is required.

1. Create a blank Draft in the approved environment and record the agent identity.

2. Copy and save the reviewed [global instructions](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/manual/GLOBAL-INSTRUCTIONS.md), including all source and action limits.

3. Upload the 2 content files from the [knowledge inventory](2.Architecture.md#knowledge-inventory); wait for ingestion to finish.

4. Upload each of the 7 files from the [skill inventory](2.Architecture.md#skill-inventory) once. Correct only genuine validation errors; do not manufacture an error to reproduce an old screenshot.

5. Match the recorded model `Sonnet46` and the reviewed input restrictions. Confirm the saved state and complete inventory before Preview.

6. Run each [locked prompt](4.Sample-prompts.md#per-case-acceptance-matrix) in a fresh Preview conversation. Capture current-agent results and keep the agent unpublished.

For the exact UI sequence and conditional checkpoints, use the [manual tutorial](https://microsoft.github.io/aibast-agents-library/solutions/building-permit-processing/manual-tutorial.html).

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The manual permit inventory has two knowledge files, seven skills, reviewed instructions and the confirmed model. [Source](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/evals/manual-build-evidence.json)
- [ ] The inspector-skill checkpoint has current acceptance evidence, not a staged recreation of the historical failure. [Source](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/evals/manual-build-evidence.json)
- [ ] Unchanged permit prompts pass in separate fresh Preview chats on the owned Draft. [Source](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/FIELD-GUIDE.md)

## Phase 4 — Acceptance

**Synthetic demo acceptance:** expected names, identifiers, and figures below are fictional test evidence, not customer results.

- [ ] Replay all 5 locked cases (BPP-01, BPP-02, BPP-03, BPP-04, BPP-05) from the [acceptance matrix](4.Sample-prompts.md#per-case-acceptance-matrix), then the [refusal and escalation tests](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases). Compare the final responses, not approximate wording or an old recorded pass.

### Go / no-go

| Criterion | Required threshold | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Locked permit corpus | All five cases, BPP-01 through BPP-05, satisfy every required and forbidden marker. | [building-permit-processing.json](../../tests/demo_cases/building-permit-processing.json) |
| Full workflow inventory | Two knowledge files, seven skills, reviewed instructions and model; no workshop tools. | [manual-build-evidence.json](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/evals/manual-build-evidence.json) |
| Inspector-skill validation | The inspector skill is accepted and visible; retry only after a recorded genuine error. | [manual-build-evidence.json](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/evals/manual-build-evidence.json) |
| Municipal authority boundary | Any permit change, sent message, inspection action, fee transaction or compliance certification is no-go. | [GLOBAL-INSTRUCTIONS.md](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/manual/GLOBAL-INSTRUCTIONS.md) |
| Visual evidence | Require current-agent target-state anchors; blank, historical published-pilot and reshoot-required frames cannot pass. | [visual-checkpoints.json](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/evals/visual-checkpoints.json) |
| Draft release | The manual release agent remains unpublished; the historical published pilot is excluded. | [manual-build-evidence.json](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/evals/manual-build-evidence.json) |

### Exit criteria

- [ ] Every permit case is judged on its complete final response, not a visual checkpoint alone. [Source](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/evals/visual-checkpoints.json)
- [ ] Chosen-lane proof is complete; any Easy/Manual comparison has matching inputs and model. [Source](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/FIELD-GUIDE.md)

## Phase 5 — Production Hardening

This is a separately approved production workstream, not another synthetic build step. Use the [qualified seams](2.Architecture.md#production-replacement-seams) as its integration boundary.

1. **Qualify — Permit service owner.** Agree permit replacement connections, governance, telemetry, support and success measures. [Basis](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/FIELD-GUIDE.md)

2. **Secure — Power Platform administrator.** Approve document, connector and channel policies; require authentication and verify denied routes stay blocked. [Basis](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/admin-data-loss-prevention)

3. **Connect — Municipal connection owners.** Map records to Dynamics 365 Customer Service, plans to SharePoint and coordination to Microsoft Teams; start approved connections read-only. [Basis](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/manual/GLOBAL-INSTRUCTIONS.md)

4. **Test — Acceptance reviewer.** Test staff and unshared identities in an approved test deployment; a maker's working connection does not prove other users' access. [Basis](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/authoring-share-agent)

5. **Release: ALM — Copilot Studio maker.** Back up the permit workspace, pull before editing and pushing, then create the package with `pac copilot pack`. [Basis](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/developer/cli/reference/copilot)

6. **Release: recovery — Power Platform administrator.** Verify backup and restore eligibility for the permit environment; rehearse recovery to a supported test target. [Basis](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/backup-restore-environments)

7. **Release: approval — Permit service owner.** Obtain explicit confirmation for the production publish operation. [Basis](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/deployment.json)

8. **Operate — Operations owner.** Review failed permit sessions, wrong-record answers, connection errors and credit consumption in Monitor. [Basis](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/analytics-overview)

### Exit criteria

- [ ] Permit replacement connections, governance, telemetry, support and success measures have named agreement. [Source](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/FIELD-GUIDE.md)
- [ ] The permit environment's recovery rehearsal uses an eligible source type and supported restore target. [Source](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/backup-restore-environments)
- [ ] Production publication has explicit confirmation independent of the historical pilot. [Source](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/deployment.json)

## Failure Recovery

| Risk | Recovery action |
| --- | --- |
| [1](1.Overview.md#what-actually-goes-wrong) | Upload unchanged; record the result. Retry only after a genuine error, and require current accepted-inventory evidence. |
| [2](1.Overview.md#what-actually-goes-wrong) | Withhold it; recapture cases and Draft state on the current Building Permit Manual Build. |
| [3](1.Overview.md#what-actually-goes-wrong) | Restore the fixed 2026-08-07 synthetic snapshot and preserve the inspection board's pending date. |
| [4](1.Overview.md#what-actually-goes-wrong) | Return only the locked response with its footer; validate the final response, not reasoning or screenshots. |
| [5](1.Overview.md#what-actually-goes-wrong) | State the missing record, list known matches and clarify; never substitute another permit. |

## Deliverables Checklist

- [ ] The Building Permit Processing Agent Draft identity, `Sonnet46` model and chosen lane are recorded.
- [ ] The 7 skills and 2 knowledge files match the Architecture inventory.
- [ ] Fresh results are retained for BPP-01, BPP-02, BPP-03, BPP-04, BPP-05.
- [ ] The 8 authored boundary tests have reviewer-recorded outcomes.
- [ ] The solution's go/no-go decision identifies remaining risks, accountable owners and the publication boundary.
